rig.skeleton: rigged assets list `skeleton`: bones (`head`) or drone nodes (`origin`) with parent, rest position in glTF axes. Every bone's rest rotation is identity.
rig.limb_bones: the bones a body part (or the prosthetic replacing it) may be skinned to
rig.skinning: each body part (head, torso, arm_l, ...) is one skinned mesh node; every vertex has weight 1.0 on one bone of `limb_bones[part]` (rigid segments). Skinned part nodes have no transform of their own: parts[].joint is the rest joint, not the node origin
rig.prosthetics: prosthetic .glb files carry the adult skeleton and a mesh skinned to the same bones: hide the body's part, move the prosthetic mesh under the body's Skeleton3D (skins bind by bone name)
rig.implants: eye implants (prosthetic_eye_*) are one part `eye` skinned to `neck` (limb_bones {"eye": ["neck"]}): keep the body's head and move the mesh under the body's Skeleton3D like a limb; or hang it on socket_head minus its attach.head point
rig.sockets: sockets[slot].bone is the attachment bone (BoneAttachment3D); identity at rest
rig.clips: one glTF animation per clip, in place (no root motion), 30 fps; `loop` says whether to loop; `events` are seconds from the clip start

images.kind: entries with `kind: "image"` (categories portrait, ui) are 2D: `file` is a PNG (sRGB, straight alpha), `size_px` its size; no 3D fields
images.portrait: bust renders framed like the game's PortraitStudio (head and shoulders, model turned -18°, ortho, top half of the figure). `character` is the 3D asset id, `variant` one of neutral / worried / angry / radio. All but radio have a transparent background; radio is an opaque amber screen for the radio frame
images.animation: `frames` lists one PNG per frame in order; `sheet` is the same frames as a sprite sheet (`cols` x `rows`, `frame_px`, left to right, top to bottom); `fps` and `loop`
images.nine_slice: frames list `nine_slice` margins [left, top, right, bottom] px (Godot NinePatchRect patch_margin_*) and `content_rect` [x, y, w, h] px
images.svg: `svg` is the vector source of the same image (palette colors only)
